scripts.build: npm test && node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && node scripts/prepare-ios-icon.mjs
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:apk:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/prepare-ios-icon.mjs
scripts.mobile:run:ios: npm run mobile:sync:ios && npx cap run ios
